newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber untraded, Deng not a factor.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber untraded, Deng not a factor.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded by midsession on Thursday with the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping not a factor in the market, dealers said.
"The death of Deng had no impact all in the market this morning. It was very dull," a dealer for a Japanese rubber trading firm said.
"What impact?" another dealer for a foreign rubber trading company said when asked if Deng's death had any impact in the local rubber market. "It was untraded. Nothing happened at all."
Prices were indicated steady to easier in line with lower prices in Tokyo.
The benchmark July contract in Tokyo dropped 2.4 yen to reach 155.4 yen in the morning session.
"It's been a very boring, morning market. What else is there to say?" another trader said.
At around 0445 GMT, April RSS3 was indicated at 121.00-123.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 123.00 cents.
April RSS1 was indicated at 172.00-174.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21-$1.22) a kg from the previous 173.25 cents.
April TSR20 was indicated at 169.00 Singapore cents (US$1.19) a kg against 169.50 cents.
